english: Let $k$ be a real number and let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=x^{3}+3x^{2}+kx+1$. If the area of the region bounded by the curves $y=f(x)$ and $y=f(-x)$ is $\dfrac{9}{25}$, then the value of $k$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $k$ एक वास्तविक संख्या है तथा $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=x^{3}+3x^{2}+kx+1$ द्वारा परिभाषित है। यदि वक्रों $y=f(x)$ तथा $y=f(-x)$ द्वारा परिबद्ध क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल $\dfrac{9}{25}$ है, तो $k$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $f(x)-f(-x)=2(x^{3}+kx)$ (the even part $3x^{2}+1$ cancels), an odd function.
Curves meet where $x(x^{2}+k)=0$; a bounded region needs $k<0$, with meeting points $0,\pm\sqrt{-k}$.
$|f(x)-f(-x)|$ is even (the two curves are mirror images in the $y$-axis), so the area $=2\displaystyle\int_{0}^{\sqrt{-k}}2(-kx-x^{3})\,dx=4\left(\dfrac{k^{2}}{2}-\dfrac{k^{2}}{4}\right)=k^{2}$
solution_full: $f(-x)=-x^{3}+3x^{2}-kx+1$, so $f(x)-f(-x)=2x^{3}+2kx=2x(x^{2}+k)$: twice the odd part of $f$; the even part $3x^{2}+1$ cancels.

The curves meet where $x(x^{2}+k)=0$. If $k\ge 0$ the only meeting point is $x=0$ and the difference keeps one sign on each side, so no bounded region exists. Hence $k<0$, and the meeting points are $x=0$, $x=\pm\sqrt{-k}$.

$y=f(-x)$ is the reflection of $y=f(x)$ in the $y$-axis, so the figure is symmetric about the $y$-axis; analytically, $|f(x)-f(-x)|$ is an even function, so $\displaystyle\int_{-c}^{c}|f(x)-f(-x)|dx=2\int_{0}^{c}|f(x)-f(-x)|dx$.
originality_note: New: the area between a cubic and its mirror image in the y-axis, which depends only on the odd part of the cubic (way 4, the even part cancels). Closest known: area between y = x^3 - x and the x-axis. Different because: the curves are not given as the odd function; the student must see that f(x) - f(-x) is twice the odd part and that the sign of k decides whether a region exists.

concept_use.Area using symmetry of the region: y = f(-x) is the reflection of y = f(x) in the y-axis, so the region is symmetric and the area is twice the part over [0, sqrt(-k)].
concept_use.Property for odd and even functions: f(x) - f(-x) = 2(x^3 + kx) is odd, its modulus is even, and the even part 3x^2 + 1 cancels.

stem_review: Read as a student: every function introduced with its domain, every condition stated, one reading, answer unique and equal to the plan; Hindi mirrors the English maths. Checked that k >= 0 gives no bounded region, so k = -0.6 is the only answer. No change.
key_step: f(x) - f(-x) = 2x(x^2 + k), area k^2 by symmetry.
justification: Routine chain (difference, roots, symmetric integral) with one sign decision; like 2024-P2-Q2 (L2).
